title: hostprototype.get
description: Retrieve host prototypes according to the given parameters.

hostids.description: Return only host prototypes with the given IDs.

discoveryids.description: Return only host prototype that belong to the given LLD rules.

inherited.description: If set to true return only items inherited from a template.

selectDiscoveryRule.description: Return a discoveryRule property with the LLD rule that the host prototype belongs to.

selectInterfaces.description: Return an interfaces property with host prototype custom interfaces.

selectGroupLinks.description: Return a groupLinks property with the group links of the host prototype.

selectGroupPrototypes.description: Return a groupPrototypes property with the group prototypes of the host prototype.

selectMacros.description: Return a macros property with host prototype macros.

selectParentHost.description: Return a parentHost property with the host that the host prototype belongs to.

selectTags.description: Return a tags property with host prototype tags.

selectTemplates.description: Return a templates property with the templates linked to the host prototype. Supports count.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values are: hostid, host, name and status.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Does not support text-type properties.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

output.description: Object properties to be returned. Default: extend.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Supports string and text properties.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
